{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0011","text":"Sorry all 23 — bed-flow alignment 10-11 CET (not EST!): Imaging/Lab/Porters each 5min, rest open"},{"spec_id":"spec_0012","text":"Line 3 jam postmortem, 1hr, 2pm ET or CT?? root cause (Dev) + fix (me) ~15min"},{"spec_id":"spec_0013","text":"Subject: Weekly sync this Thursday, sorry, need everyone live

Hi all,

Apologies for doing this to your calendars again. I know the weekly sync has mostly been a quick round of updates lately, and I've been meaning to just send those around in writing. This week is different, though, and I'd really rather we talk it through together than trade replies on a thread.

Without going into too much detail over email: the Halvorsen engagement has shifted in a way that touches all three workstreams. A couple of you have already heard pieces of it from different people at the client, and I suspect those pieces don't quite match. Before anyone responds to them, I want the seven of us in one room (virtual room) to sort out what we actually know, what we're willing to commit to, and who owns which conversation going forward. That last part is the one I'm most worried about getting wrong.

30 minutes, Thursday at 9:00. And here's where I apologize a second time: I sent the original hold as 9:00 Singapore time, which is very much not what I meant. It's 9:00 London. Priya and Tomasz, I realize that's an early start for you in Singapore anyway. If it's unworkable, tell me and I'll shift it to 8:30 London. Marco, you're on Lisbon time, so it's the same clock for you.

Please don't prep slides. Just come with whatever you've heard from the client side since Monday, even if it's only hallway stuff.

Thanks for bearing with me. I owe everyone coffee.

Wen
